dispositions.runtime allocation and deallocation ABI: HEAP/REPL: replace raw managed deallocation harness with allocator/collect/domain checks.
dispositions.safe free accepts local allocation and e: SYNTAX; preserve alias/reference semantics in GC-root controls.
dispositions.safe free rejects live aliases and escap: SYNTAX; replace dangling-managed checks with root survival plus separate foreign-lifetime negatives.
dispositions.destructor and constructor effects are c: SYNTAX/REPL: remove destructor effects, retain initialization/resource/callback effect negatives.
dispositions.deterministic destructors and rollback r: SYNTAX/REPL: zeroed/published failed construction and explicit acquisition rollback.
dispositions.unnamed temporaries match handwritten cl: HEAP/SYNTAX: no implicit destruction; retain operand/exception ordering and add root/reclamation controls.
dispositions.deferred calls preserve exit and failure: PRES with destructor/free portions split out; add collection during cleanup.
dispositions.deferred calls flush and close loopback: PRES resource behavior; remove managed frees and use deliberate collect for heap assertions.
dispositions.deferred free enforces local syntax and: SYNTAX; add obsolete-form diagnostics and ordinary method named free in defer.
dispositions.finally preserves primary exceptions and: PRES; collect with primary/secondary graph in flight.
dispositions.unfreed options preserve native output a: SYNTAX; replace with removed-option/directive errors across artifact inputs.
dispositions.pool release helpers preserve borrows an: PRES pool protocol/allocation baseline; HEAP for immediate live-count restoration.
dispositions.pool release helper proofs preserve mand: SYNTAX for heap-free negatives; PRES/REPL wrong-pool/foreign-resource safety.
dispositions.pool release helper proofs survive artif: PRES source/class/archive equivalence; HEAP assertion migration.
dispositions.catchable allocation failure boundaries: PRES failure order/immortal OOM; REPL no-automatic-collection control.
dispositions.allocation failure primary and secondary: PRES; HEAP rollback counts replaced by post-collect counts.
dispositions.native Throwable trace storage survives: PRES traces/bounded OOM; HEAP/REPL sidecar graph and no finalizer.
dispositions.trace bookkeeping preserves allocation c: PRES total-allocation boundary; SYNTAX free; REPL exact accounting after collect.
dispositions.Java Bridge root JNI payloads preserve m: PRES mutation/delivery failure; HEAP/REPL anchors and published partial graph.
dispositions.Java Bridge private long callbacks prese: PRES failure containment; REPL explicit suspended-segment roots. Existing pass does not prove collecting JVM reentry.
dispositions.Java Bridge byte-view proofs preserve ty: PRES; REPL collection inside supported borrow and refusal outside lifetime.
dispositions.Java Bridge generated root state preserv: HEAP/REPL handle/anchor closure, independent aliases, stale identity and image isolation.
dispositions.Java Bridge production scalar libraries: PRES no new scalar maintenance; REPL new ABI identity and incompatible-image refusal.

limits: One local macOS arm64 baseline; no production layout/root/reentry qualification.
Collector guard remains 16 GiB sampled RSS and 60 seconds per child; short runs can finish between samples.
No resident-capacity or self-hosting claim; no unfiltered suite.
GC1 must validate build compatibility and symbol isolation; GC2 must qualify all production accounting kinds.
